sources.entry: Matcha - Keep your Mac awake with a visual timer, a floating badge, and detection of AI coding agents. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jakeantelis/Matcha) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Matcha is a free, open-source, native Swift menu bar app for macOS that keeps your Mac awake (including screen and lock screen) during long tasks, with a visual timer and detection of AI coding agents.
use_cases: Keep a Mac awake during audio or video exports and renders
Prevent sleep during big downloads or backups
Keep the Mac awake for long builds via matcha run
Stay unlocked while a coding agent is working
Schedule awake sessions or stop at a clock time
Control sleep from Raycast, Alfred, or Shortcuts
how_to_run: Download Matcha.dmg from the releases page and open it
Launch Matcha and click the cup icon in the menu bar
notable: Detects 45+ AI coding agents and can auto-start or prompt to keep awake
Tea-fill visual timer plus floating desktop badge
Battery guard, idle auto-stop, and clamshell/lid-closed support
matcha run -- <command> stays awake exactly as long as the command runs
Crash-safe timed sessions that resume after a crash or force-quit
caveats: Lock screen is kept away only while a session is active; README advises enabling idle auto-stop when stepping away
Clamshell support only works while on power and connected to a display
Build from source needs Xcode Command Line Tools
